name: Draft Horse
appearance: A heavy chestnut draft horse with a dark mane and tail and pale feathering around its hooves.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, DDEX3-05 Bane of the Tradeways, September 1, 2015 release, Draft Horse, p. 26.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 9 (2d4 + 4) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Caravan encounter: Each wagon has a four-horse team wearing half-plate barding. The hitch and harness skirting gives the horses half cover. The scenario allows the Large horses to run abreast in a 10-ft.-wide space. Their attacks and Dexterity saves during combat there are at disadvantage.

name: Riding Horse
appearance: A lean bay riding horse with a dark mane, dark tail and dark lower legs.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, DDEX3-05 Bane of the Tradeways, September 1, 2015 release, Riding Horse, p. 26.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Melee weapon attack, +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.
sections.Encounter ecology: The adventure offers one saddled riding horse per character near the ambush. The horses shy away from the fighting and stay nearby.

name: Cooshee (Mastiff)
otherStatistics: Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages.
appearance: A broad-chested elven hound with a moss-green coat mottled with irregular dark brown patches and a strong muzzle.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, DDAL04-06 The Ghost, Version 1.0, 2016, Cooshee (Mastiff), p. 24.
sections.Traits: Keen Hearing and Smell. The cooshee has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 11 Strength saving throw or fall prone.
sections.Encounter ecology: Long-lived elven hounds have greenish fur mottled with brown, a loud bark and powerful jaws. Derali’s two cooshees track a scent and guard her party.

name: Giant Wolf Spider
otherStatistics: Perception +3. Stealth +7. Blindsight 10 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages.
appearance: A low, hairy spider with stout banded legs and a dark-striped brown abdomen.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, DDAL04-06 The Ghost, Version 1.0, 2016, Giant Wolf Spider, p. 26.
sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. It can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings while upside down, without an ability check.
Web Sense. When touching a web, the spider knows the exact position of any other creature touching that web.
Web Walker. Webbing does not restrict its movement.
sections.Actions: Bites. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 11 Constitution saving throw and takes 7 (2d6) poison damage on a failure or half on a success. If the poison drops the target to 0 hit points, it is stable and poisoned for 1 hour even if it regains hit points. It is paralyzed while poisoned this way.
sections.Encounter ecology: The adventure uses this spider in place of ettercaps when adjusting the forest nest encounter for a weak party.

name: Frederick (Mastiff)
otherStatistics: Perception +3. Passive Perception 13. No listed languages.
appearance: A hefty tricolor basset hound with short legs, a long body and low-hanging brown ears.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, DDAL04-08 The Broken One, Version 1.0, 2016, Frederick (Mastiff), p. 22.
sections.Traits: Keen Smell. Frederick has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d6 + 1) piercing damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 11 Strength saving throw or fall prone.
sections.Encounter ecology: Frederick is Scartia Krutz’s very large basset hound. He keeps trying to climb into her lap at dinner.
